subject.title: Upgrade 2026.6.8→2026.6.9 corrupts email channel config with spurious groupAllowFrom field

question: Should OpenClaw accept the fail-closed doctor write behavior for schemaless external channels as the fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug and fix location are well supported, but changing a released doctor migration default for external plugins is a compatibility-sensitive maintainer choice.

options.title: Land the focused guard
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95540 after normal gates if maintainers agree core must not write fields into external channel config it cannot validate.

options.title: Fold into broader protection
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the broader config-protection work to prove the same email/RCS regression before closing it.

options.title: Wait for packaged upgrade proof
options.body: Delay the fix until a maintainer or reporter reruns a packaged ClawMail upgrade against a candidate build.

recommendation.title: Land the focused guard
recommendation.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95540 after normal gates if maintainers agree core must not write fields into external channel config it cannot validate.

likelyOwner.reason: The original migration was introduced through this owner path, and the remaining choice is whether to accept the compatibility-sensitive default change.
